ops.text: askdesk.RunOnMac (storedesk.go:140) follows with Reader: client.Stem(lane), but Desk.answer (askdesk.go:144) addresses the answer To: ask.Lane, the numbered lane. cci's Follow sets Filter.For to the reader with no stem expansion, and a stem reader does not read a numbered lane's exact mail (cc-inbox v0.53.3 internal/cli/embed.go:215, internal/store/holds.go:376-405). Evidence (codex sol xhigh, run codex-run.72c2336c.../registry-answer-lag): both answers reached their Sprites whole within 0.53 s and 0.89 s (pool-u64cg2s5i55vtdj2 seq 979 resolves 977; pool-vnprumqaywxjbvfj seq 1130 resolves 1128), so push, relay, body inlining and resolves translation are ruled out. A live /v1/follow probe on the Sprite daemon with For=test-sleeps-ts emitted nothing in 3 s; For=test-sleeps-ts-1 emitted first:979 in 15 ms. Every store-desk read from a numbered Sprite lane hits this, not only handoff-registry. The 50 KB names array (2,416 names) is overhead but not the cause. Fix: Reader: lane.
